articles.summary: Ameris Choice Program Offers up to $10,000 for Qualified Homebuyers in Atlanta Ameris Bank is supporting first-time homebuyers with the expansion of its Ameris Choice homebuyer assistance program. Now, qualified homebuyers purchasing in eligible markets in Atlanta can receive up to $10,000 in down payment assistance through the program. Ameris Choice brings tailored assistance to more communities while continuing to promote equitable access to homeownership. The program is available to qualified first-time homebuyers purchasing a primary residence in eligible areas, including metropolitan Deltona/Daytona, Jacksonville, Ocala and Tallahassee, Florida; Atlanta and Gainesville, Georgia; Greenville, South Carolina; and certain designated affordable housing community development areas in Charleston, South Carolina. “Atlanta continues to see strong demand for affordable homeownership options, and we recognize that down payment costs can be one of the biggest barriers for first-time buyers,”
articles.title: Ameris Bank Expands Down Payment Assistance Program

articles.summary: Ameris Bank is pleased to welcome seasoned banking executive Carl Insel as leader of its Atlanta market. Insel has more than 35 years of financial services experience and deep relationships in the Atlanta market. Insel spent the last 16 years with First Citizens Bank, where he served as regional executive vice president. He has strong ties to the Atlanta area, having spent nearly a decade with SunTrust, now Truist, in commercial, retail, private and business banking. His experience building high-performing teams and driving relationship-based deposit growth will support Ameris Bank’s continued momentum in the market. “Carl’s extensive banking experience and strong understanding of the Atlanta market make him an excellent addition to Ameris Bank,” said Lawton Bassett, Ameris Bank president. “His proven ability to lead teams, build relationships and support customer growth will help us continue serving customers and communities across the region.” About Ameris Bank Ameris Bank, a
articles.title: Ameris Bank Welcomes Carl Insel to Lead Atlanta Market

articles.summary: Ameris Bancorp (NYSE: ABCB) (the “Company”) announced today that it intends to release its second quarter 2026 financial results in a press release after the market closes on Thursday, July 23, 2026. H. Palmer Proctor, Jr., Chief Executive Officer, Nicole S. Stokes, Chief Financial Officer, and Douglas D. Strange, Chief Credit Officer, will host a teleconference at 9:00 a.m. Eastern time on Friday, July 24, 2026 to discuss the Company's results and answer appropriate questions. The conference call can be accessed by dialing 1-844-481-2939. The conference call ID is Ameris Bancorp. A replay of the call will be available beginning one hour after the end of the conference call until July 31, 2026. To listen to the replay, dial 1-855-669-9658. The conference replay access code is 7503680. The financial information discussed will be available on the Investor Relations page of the Ameris Bank website at ir.amerisbank.com .
